I study how wireless networks can become more intelligent, secure, and useful for connected environments. My work brings together **integrated sensing and communications (ISAC)**, UAV-assisted networks, RIS-assisted communications, physical-layer security, IoT, and optimization for B5G/6G systems.

## Research at a glance

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .research-card}
### ISAC
Jointly designing communication and sensing functions for future wireless systems.
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .research-card}
### UAV networks
Reliable aerial connectivity, trajectory design, resource allocation, and UAV-MEC.
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .research-card}
### Security & RIS
Secure NOMA, authentication, RIS/FRIS, and intelligent radio environments.
:::
:::
